digo: Mfidzofidzo; Mfunga sandzu (also Kisambwe, Mfunga tanzu)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005

teaser.en: Its branches grow in threes, perfect for the three-pronged stick used to stir porridge, and the tree is named after it.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake hukua matatu matatu, kamili kwa mwiko wa ncha tatu wa kusongea uji, na mti huu umepewa jina kutokana nao.
teaser.dg: Pandaze zinamera tahu-tahu, na ni nono sana kuhenda *lifidzo*, chigongo cha ntsa tahu cha kufwidzira uji; na muhi uhewa dzinare kula kpwa chombo hichi.

summary.en: *Mfidzofidzo*, the African mangosteen, is an evergreen tree whose orange fruit is one of the most delicious wild fruits of the coast. Its branches, growing in threes, give the stirring stick that names the tree.
summary.sw: *Mfidzofidzo*, au mpekechu, ni mti wa kijani kibichi ambao tunda lake la rangi ya chungwa ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini matamu zaidi ya pwani. Matawi yake, yanayokua matatu matatu, hutoa mwiko wa kusongea ambao ndio jina la mti huu.
summary.dg: *Mfidzofidzo* (*African mangosteen* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, ambao tundare ra rangi ya chungbwa ni kahi ya matunda ga weruni ga mtswano zaidi ga pwani. Pandaze zinazomera tahu-tahu zinalavya *lifidzo* ra kufwidzira, na dzina ra muhi rinalavywa kula kpwa chombo hichi.

about.en:
*Mfidzofidzo* is an evergreen tree of 2 to 10 metres with a heavy, cone-shaped crown. Its branches typically grow in threes, all from one point, and its stiff, leathery leaves grow in pairs or threes.

Cut the bark and a yellow-red latex oozes out. The fruits are round and bright orange, with thin skin and juicy, sweet-sour flesh.
about.sw:
*Mfidzofidzo* ni mti wa kijani kibichi wa mita 2 hadi 10 wenye kilele kizito chenye umbo la koni. Kwa kawaida matawi yake hukua matatu matatu, yote kutoka sehemu moja, na majani yake magumu kama ngozi hukua mawili mawili au matatu matatu.

Ukikata gome, utomvu wa rangi ya manjano-nyekundu hutiririka. Matunda yake ni ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa angavu, yenye ganda jembamba na nyama yenye maji mengi, tamu na chachu.
about.dg:
*Mfidzofidzo* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita 2 hadi 10, wenye makodza manji ga dzulu maziho ganayohenda umbo ra *cone*. Pandaze kpwa kawaida zinamera tahu-tahu, zosi kula phatu phamwenga, na makodzage magumu dza chingo ganamera airi-airi au mahahu-mahahu.

Uchikata gopha, utomvu wa rangi ya mandano na kundu unatuluka. Matunda ni ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa inayong'ala, gana gada rembamba na nyama yenye madzi manji, ya mtswano na ngbwadu.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest, in thicket and on rocky outcrops. Look for its dark, conical crown and its branches arranged in threes.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya kando ya mito, katika vichaka vizito na juu ya miamba. Tafuta kilele chake cheusi chenye umbo la koni na matawi yake yaliyopangwa matatu matatu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho, vitsakani na phatu phenye mawe. Uhendze makodzage ga dzulu ga rangi nyiru ga umbo ra *cone*, na pandaze zinazomera tahu-tahu.

uses.en:
The fruit is one of the most delicious wild fruits of the coast and is eaten fresh.

The three-pronged twigs are made into sticks for stirring porridge. The wood is also used for poles and spoons, the root is used in medicine, and the bark gives a dye.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini matamu zaidi ya pwani na huliwa likiwa bichi.

Vitawi vyenye ncha tatu hutengenezwa kuwa miiko ya kusongea uji. Mti wake pia hutumika kwa nguzo na miiko, mizizi hutumika kama dawa, na gome hutoa rangi.
uses.dg:
Tunda ni kahi ya matunda ga weruni ga mtswano zaidi ga pwani, na nkuriwa dza ririvyo.

Maphungo genye ntsa tahu nkuhendwa vyombo vya kufwidzira uji (*lifidzo*). Nyama za muhi piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo na vidziko, muzi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, na gopha rinalavya rangi.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the name *mfidzofidzo* comes from *lifidzo*, the three-pronged stirring stick made from its branches. It is a tree named for the kitchen tool it provides.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa jina *mfidzofidzo* linatokana na *lifidzo*, mwiko wa ncha tatu wa kusongea unaotengenezwa kwa matawi yake. Ni mti uliopewa jina kutokana na chombo cha jikoni unachotoa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala dzina *mfidzofidzo* rinalavywa kula *lifidzo*, chigongo cha ntsa tahu cha kufwidzira chinachohendwa kula kpwa pandaze. Ni muhi uriohewa dzina kula kpwa chombo cha dzikoni chinachohendwa kpwakpwe.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo names *mfidzofidzo* and *mfunga sandzu*, also *kisambwe* and *mfunga tanzu*. In Swahili it is *mpekechu*, *mpeketo* or *mtotozi*. In Giriama it is *mufodzohi*. In English it is the African mangosteen or imbe, and its scientific name is *Garcinia livingstonei*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina ya Kidigo *mfidzofidzo* na *mfunga sandzu*, pamoja na *kisambwe* na *mfunga tanzu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mpekechu*, *mpeketo* au *mtotozi*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mufodzohi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African mangosteen* au *imbe*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Garcinia livingstonei*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina ga Chidigo *mfidzofidzo* na *mfunga sandzu*, na piya *kisambwe* na *mfunga tanzu*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mpekechu*, *mpeketo* au *mtotozi*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mufodzohi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African mangosteen* au *imbe*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Garcinia livingstonei*.
